source.title: Pathfinder #170: Spoken on the Song Wind

items.name: Motion Sense 60 feet
items.text: A sewer ooze can sense nearby motion through vibration and air movements.

items.name: Noxious Scent
items.text: 30 feet. A creature that enters the area must attempt a DC 23 Fortitude save save. On a failure, the creature is Sickened 1 (Sickened 2 on a critical failure). A creature taking persistent acid damage from the ooze's pseudopod can't recover from the sickened condition. A creature that succeeds at its save is temporarily immune for 1 minute.

items.name: Filth Wave
items.text:
Frequency once per minute

---

Effect The sewer ooze unleashes a wave of filth, covering all creatures within a 20-foot emanation. Each creature in the area must succeed at a DC 24 Reflex save save or take 1d4 acid damage and a –10-foot penalty to its Speeds for 1 minute (on a critical failure, the creature also falls Prone). A creature can spend an Interact action to clean someone off, decreasing the Speed penalty by 5 feet with each action.

Effect: Filth Wave
